data.narrative:
Sift Stack, an AI & Software company founded by Karthik Gollapudi and Austin Spiegel, is a Series B stage enterprise having raised $67M to date. Valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 3 same-stage, same-sector private comparables—Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B)—alongside 1 public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and a broader set of 8 private frontier-tech peers.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-round step-ups, implies a valuation of $127M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.2B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $5.6B. The disparity between these methods reflects meaningful heterogeneity within frontier AI valuations at this stage.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $108M to $3.7B, with a median implied value of $1.7B. The wide spread reflects uncertainty around market positioning relative to the peer set: Sift Stack's ultimate valuation depends critically on capital efficiency, revenue trajectory, and defensibility relative to comparables spanning nearly a 3x range. Stage-progression alone appears underweighted given the peer median; however, without revenue or customer metrics, the peer-median method carries model risk tied to comparability assumptions.
